info.name: Datalastic Maritime Historical Reports and Usage API
Check report status or list reports

params.name: report_id
params.description: The report identifier to check, or _all to list all reports.

items.docs: Polls the status of an asynchronous report job by report_id. Status progresses through PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, and DONE; when DONE, a result_url download link is returned. Pass report_id=_all to list all of your reports. Checking status is free.

Submits a bulk report job as a JSON payload. The response includes a report_id used to poll GET /report for status. Report submission deducts 1 credit; large dataset reports such as a full vessel list (5,000 credits) or port list (500 credits) are priced per dataset.
Returns your current monthly credit consumption and request statistics for the api-key. Usage requests are free and do not deduct credits.
